The '''Coalition Command Post''' was a military outpost established on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Revanite crisis]] by the [[Yavin Coalition]] forces under [[Darth Marr]] and [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coalition Command Post appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
